status: Milestone membership settled by evidence and explicit user decisions: 43 included; 123 excluded (including Recall Past Life by provisional project ruling); Aspirational State skipped as one unverified exception.

rituals.name: Amity Cycle
rituals.reason: Performance grants social bonuses and temporary HP; backlash blocks emotion bonuses.

rituals.name: Angelic Messenger
rituals.reason: Planar travel outcomes have no saves; hazardous destination alone does not qualify.

rituals.name: Anima Invocation (Modified)
rituals.reason: Save bonuses, resistance, Strike benefits and doomed backlash do not require saves.

rituals.name: Animate Object
rituals.reason: Creature creation only; independent construct abilities and hostile attacks excluded.

rituals.name: Antimagic Artifice
rituals.reason: Antimagic suppression and fixed, irreducible stupefied backlash; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Arcane Weaving
rituals.reason: Repertoire exchange and fixed stupefied backlash; later spellcasting excluded.

rituals.name: Army of Shadows
rituals.reason: Light counteraction and fixed blindness backlash; counteract checks are not saves.

rituals.name: Ash-Strewn Ending
rituals.reason: Grants bonuses/penalties against death effects and recovery checks, not saving throws caused by ritual.

rituals.name: Asmodean Wager
rituals.reason: All bettors must participate willingly; life stake explicitly has no save. Promise stake imports Geas, whose willing application has no save and whose sickened cannot be removed by recovery saves. Ninth rank merely allows unwilling targets in ordinary Geas; Wager forbids coerced participants.

rituals.name: Aspirational State
rituals.reason: User confirmed they do not have the missing source and explicitly instructed: no. skip that. Aspiration Points rules on page 7 of PFS #2-22 Excising Ruination (PZOPFS0222E) remain unavailable. Omitted from this milestone by accepted exception, not classified as rule-proven excluded.

decision.revisitWhen: The Aspiration Points rules become available and the user restores this item to scope.

rituals.name: Astral Projection
rituals.reason: Astral-form death requires Fortitude save to avoid actual death.

rituals.name: Atone
rituals.reason: Atonement restores abilities or expels target from faith, no save.

rituals.name: Awaken Animal
rituals.reason: Intelligence awakening and creature attitude changes; independent creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Awaken Curse
rituals.reason: Awakened curse leaps to nearby targets on counteraction, explicitly requiring initial curse saves.

rituals.name: Awaken Object
rituals.reason: Object awareness or trapped intellect in unconscious body; later Animate Object is separate ritual.

rituals.name: Awaken Portal
rituals.reason: Can awaken Teleportation Circle, whose active portal forces unwilling entrants to attempt Will saves, repeated at turn end.

rituals.name: Bacchanalia
rituals.reason: Celebrants fascinated with ordinary hostile-action ending; no saving throw specified.

rituals.name: Band of Heroes
rituals.reason: Mythic Aid bonuses or loss of points; recovery checks are not saves.

rituals.name: Bathe in Blood
rituals.reason: Rejuvenation or automatic death; no save.

rituals.name: Beckon the Blasphemous Brethren
rituals.reason: Summons venedaemon; its service or hostile actions are independent creature abilities.

rituals.name: Binding Circle
rituals.reason: Unwilling extraplanar creature attempts Will save to remain on home plane.

rituals.name: Blight
rituals.reason: Crop alteration/counteraction and GM-directed plant changes; no concrete save effect.

rituals.name: Blunt the Final Blade
rituals.reason: Soul liberation and save bonus; critical failure releases attacking gray death, an independent created creature.

rituals.name: Bonding Meal
rituals.reason: Memory sharing and social-check adjustments; no save.

rituals.name: Borrow Time
rituals.reason: Time suspension, repayment and aging; no save.

rituals.name: Bountiful Oasis
rituals.reason: Unspecified sickening water and disease exposure do not establish a mechanical condition or required save; general environmental and GM-imposed consequences alone do not qualify.

rituals.name: Butterfly Bender
rituals.reason: Destiny-driven story outcomes, items, contacts and skill modifiers; intoxication description does not define poison saves.

rituals.name: Call Spirit
rituals.reason: Unwilling spirit attempts Will save to resist call.

rituals.name: City of Sin
rituals.reason: Save modifiers and behavioral alteration, without a save against ritual.

rituals.name: Clone
rituals.reason: Clone creation and fixed post-revival conditions; no saves.

rituals.name: Cloudborne Haven
rituals.reason: Falling-structure consequences are general environmental handling; no explicit ritual save identified.

rituals.name: Collective Memories
rituals.reason: Information gathering or one-week unresponsiveness; no save.

rituals.name: Commune
rituals.reason: Information and fixed stupefied backlash; no save.

rituals.name: Commune with Corazal
rituals.reason: Information, granted navigation spell, drained/stupefied and recovery flat check; flat check not save.

rituals.name: Community Repair
rituals.reason: Repair and save/speed bonuses or penalties; no required save.

rituals.name: Concealment's Curtain
rituals.reason: Vision suppression, blindness and direct heightened damage lack saves; cited cleansing spells are remedies, not produced effects.

rituals.name: Confound the Eye and Confuse the Mind
rituals.reason: Recognizing disguised spell explicitly requires Will save.

rituals.name: Consecrate
rituals.reason: Bonuses/penalties; heightened Planar Seal only counteracts teleportation, no save.

rituals.name: Construct Mindscape
rituals.reason: Remastered Mindscape Statistics and its Finite, Metamorphic, and Subjective Gravity traits establish no saving throw. Ritual creation/entry and veiling impose no specified save; possible environmental consequences and optional GM inventions remain outside the accepted inclusion policy.

rituals.name: Contact Friends
rituals.reason: Information and fixed stupefied backlash; no save.

rituals.name: Control Weather
rituals.reason: General weather hazards do not qualify the ritual; no explicit ritual save identified.

rituals.name: Corpse Communion
rituals.reason: Unspecified GM-discretion affliction exposure does not establish a required ritual save.

rituals.name: Create Demiplane
rituals.reason: Planar traits can cause eventual drowning or suffocation saves, but these are excluded general environmental consequences.

rituals.name: Create Mycoguardian
rituals.reason: Fungus creation; independent created-creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Create Skinstitch
rituals.reason: Construct creation; independent created-creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Create Undead
rituals.reason: Undead creation; independent created-creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Curse of Calamity
rituals.reason: Fortune penalties and GM-adjudicated accidents; no concrete saving throw or inherited effect.

rituals.name: Daemonic Pact
rituals.reason: Daemon service and drained backlash; independent creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Demonic Pact
rituals.reason: Demon service/hostility; independent creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Destroy Mindscape
rituals.reason: Mindscape destruction, displacement and drained; unspecified separate escape challenges are not ritual saves.

rituals.name: Diabolic Pact
rituals.reason: Devil service and patron displeasure; independent creature abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Div Pact
rituals.reason: Div service or suppression of innate spells; independent abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Divine Keystone
rituals.reason: Undead ward/invisibility or undead regeneration; no save.

rituals.name: Drain Planar Connection
rituals.reason: Failure and critical failure force DC26 basic Reflex save against force backlash.

rituals.name: Dread Ambience
rituals.reason: Save penalties only; no ritual-caused saving throw.

rituals.name: Elemental Sentinel
rituals.reason: Sentinel sensing/reporting only, not offensive elemental abilities.

rituals.name: Elemental Servitor
rituals.reason: Calls a servitor; any subsequent creature attacks or abilities are independent, and unspecified divine displeasure supplies no mandated save.

rituals.name: Embodied Font
rituals.reason: Restores body and resources; failure imposes fixed-duration clumsy, drained, doomed, and enfeebled without a save or recovery save.

rituals.name: Empower Ley Line
rituals.reason: Enhances a ley line and inherits its backlash on critical failure. All five published sample backlashes have no save (conditions, persistent damage, blink displacement, casting cost). Custom backlash is not a baseline qualifying rule.

rituals.name: Encroaching Woods
rituals.reason: Moves and conceals a forest; critical failure directly petrifies as wood without a save; counteraction is not a saving throw.

rituals.name: Entreat Thunderbird
rituals.reason: Changes thunderbird attitude; no save in any result.

rituals.name: Establish Nexus
rituals.reason: Creates nexus; critical failure inherits ley-line backlashes. None of the five published sample backlashes requires a save. Custom lines require separate assessment.

rituals.name: Extract Brain
rituals.reason: Removes brain, with mandatory body death and possible hostile entity; no saving throw, including heightened golem options.

rituals.name: Fantastic Facade
rituals.reason: Disbelief uses non-save checks by default. A GM substitution of a save alone does not qualify the ritual.

rituals.name: Feast of Supplication
rituals.reason: Cooking contest adjusts patron requests and attitudes; no save or recovery-save condition.

rituals.name: Fey Abeyance
rituals.reason: Cold iron ward and bell squares deal nonlethal mental damage without a save; mischievous fey encounter on failure is independent.

rituals.name: Footholds and Foothills
rituals.reason: Remove mode explicitly offers Grab an Edge to creatures on destroyed terrain. That referenced action permits an Acrobatics check or Reflex save, so a legal ritual-resolution choice is save-bearing.

rituals.name: Form of the Sandpoint Devil
rituals.reason: Grants transformation and separately activated Accursed Breath; generated creatures on failure act independently. No ritual-imposed save apart from excluded independent later abilities.

rituals.name: Fortifying Brew
rituals.reason: Critical failure imposes sickened 4 and prohibits reduction for 12 hours. After that lock expires normal sickened Fortitude recovery applies; restorative referenced spells counteract rather than force saves.

rituals.name: Freedom
rituals.reason: Critical failure applies the target imprisonment/stasis magic to casters. For an Imprisonment Chains target, the inherited effect requires later Will saves by creatures approaching or freeing those imprisoned.

rituals.name: Garden of Death
rituals.reason: Critical failure explicitly inflicts bites by the most poisonous local creature on each caster; this is the ritual outcome, not independently chosen later monster activity. A legal viper bite exposes to venom with Fortitude saves. Exact local creature/poison is GM input; affliction progression delegated.

rituals.name: Gathering Call
rituals.reason: Voluntary sanctuary return or misdirected planar travel; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Geas
rituals.reason: Rank 5 and higher allow unwilling targets and explicitly grant Will saves. Its sickened condition cannot be reduced except by compliance, so that is not a separate recovery-save path.

rituals.name: Glance of the Divine
rituals.reason: Sanctification or separately granted Domain Initiate feat; no save as ritual result. Later granted spellcasting is excluded.

rituals.name: Gnaw at the Moon
rituals.reason: Vision benefits or drained for 24 hours; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Guardian's Aegis
rituals.reason: Damage sharing and awareness; no save. Mention of poison preserves an independent incoming attack effect rather than creating a new exposure.

rituals.name: Halt Death
rituals.reason: Save bonuses and altered recovery checks; dying recovery is a flat check, not a save. Doomed backlash has fixed duration without a recovery save.

rituals.name: Harrowing
rituals.reason: Optional fortune rerolls of independently occurring checks, including saves; ritual itself does not require a saving throw.

rituals.name: Haven in the Ether
rituals.reason: Creates planar haven; pest encounter on failure is independent creature activity, with no ritual-imposed save.

rituals.name: Heartbond
rituals.reason: Communication bond and telepathy; fixed-duration clumsy/stupefied backlash, with no save. Referenced telepathy grants communication only.

rituals.name: Ideal Mimicry
rituals.reason: Doll interaction directly deals mental damage, including reflected failure damage, with no save at any heightened rank.

rituals.name: Imprisonment
rituals.reason: Chains form explicitly requires Will saves from other creatures attempting to approach, harm chains, or free prisoner; critical failure can create the same effect on casters.

rituals.name: Incarnate Ancestry
rituals.reason: Ancestry change with clumsy/stupefied fixed periods; no save or sickened recovery.

rituals.name: Inveigle
rituals.reason: Unwilling targets attempt Will to negate; later requests against nature/interests permit Will to end the ritual.

rituals.name: Kaiju Ward
rituals.reason: Structure AC, Hardness, resistance, and HP adjustments; no creature save.

rituals.name: Labyrinthine Prison
rituals.reason: Unwilling target explicitly attempts Will to resist imprisonment; subsequent escape is skill/Perception, not a save.

rituals.name: Last Night's Vigil
rituals.reason: Healing and affliction-stage reduction; does not impose an affliction or trigger a save. Fatigued backlash expires after 24 hours.

rituals.name: Loyalty's Ward
rituals.reason: Trapped creatures explicitly attempt Will saves to leave, with retry interval dependent on ritual degree.

rituals.name: Lucky Month
rituals.reason: Fortune/misfortune modifies separately occurring saves or skill checks; no ritual-created saving throw.

rituals.name: Mind Swap
rituals.reason: Mind exchange and fixed stupefied backlash; no saving throw, including permanent heightened form.

rituals.name: Mindscape Door
rituals.reason: Critical-failure option inflicts mental damage with basic Will DC26, or DC40 at rank8.

rituals.name: Mindscape Shift
rituals.reason: GM-only description explicitly gives basic Will DC26 against mental-feedback critical failure. Value field is empty but gm field is authoritative local text.

rituals.name: Mosquito Blight
rituals.reason: Area exposure and critical-failure exposure to Witch's Hunger disease explicitly use Fortitude saving throws; progression remains delegated.

rituals.name: Mother's Blessing
rituals.reason: Purifies eggs, with hatch/failure/destruction results; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Mystic Carriage
rituals.reason: Creates a carriage with a Fortitude statistic, not a forced creature save; horse attack on critical failure is independent.

rituals.name: Oblivious Expulsion
rituals.reason: Unwilling target explicitly attempts Will to negate memory removal.

rituals.name: Ocean's Roar
rituals.reason: Flood and drowning consequences are general environmental handling; independently acting created creatures also do not qualify the ritual.

rituals.name: Oil-Slicked Walls
rituals.reason: Critical failure explicitly gives each caster choice of Reflex save or Balance check on first movement each encounter for one week.

rituals.name: Open the Wall of Ghosts
rituals.reason: GM-only description opens passage and gives AC/save bonuses; failure spawns independent ghost attackers. Consecrate is historical development, not inheritance of its outcome rules.

rituals.name: Owb Pact
rituals.reason: Calls owb, with direct doomed 2 backlash; no saving throw or recovery save.

rituals.name: Peer Into the Past
rituals.reason: Recreates scene; critical failure makes scene creatures hostile, but their later abilities are independent; no disbelief check or mandated save in the ritual.

rituals.name: Perfection of Essence
rituals.reason: Completion requires poison with explicit Fortitude DC43; failures alter first save and virulence. Affliction progression remains delegated.

rituals.name: Phantasmal Custodians
rituals.reason: Referenced Phantasmal Minion summons a creature; hostile minions make Strikes, no save-producing ritual outcome.

rituals.name: Phantom Ship
rituals.reason: Falling into water can eventually cause drowning saves, but these are excluded general environmental consequences.

rituals.name: Plague Shot
rituals.reason: Ammunition impact exposes creatures to Siege Sickness (Fortitude DC24); critical failure directly exposes casters' area. This is a ritual payload trigger, with progression delegated.

rituals.name: Planar Displacement
rituals.reason: Planar transport/misdirection/travel lock; no save.

rituals.name: Planar Servitor
rituals.reason: Calls divine servitor; unspecified displeasure and independent later attacks do not mandate saving throws.

rituals.name: Plant Growth
rituals.reason: Crop growth or counteraction of Blight; counteract is not a save. Unspecified botanical alteration supplies no mandatory saving throw.

rituals.name: Portrait of Spite
rituals.reason: Target explicitly makes Will against the chosen curse condition, with degree-specific condition values.

rituals.name: Power of the Beasts
rituals.reason: Grants Titan Wrestler after proof; critical failure sickened lasts one week and cannot be reduced during that entire fixed duration, so no recovery-save window.

rituals.name: Primal Call
rituals.reason: Inherits Planar Servitor with different creature selection; no ritual save. Creature abilities remain independent.

rituals.name: Purify Soul Path
rituals.reason: Removes soulforged corruption after atonement/quest; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Purify Tanglebriar
rituals.reason: Critical failure forces DC38 basic Fortitude save against void backlash.

rituals.name: Raga of Remembrance
rituals.reason: Critical failure afflicts casters with named many-eyed blight; Kothogaz source defines Fortitude DC44 and stages. Affliction progression remains delegated.

rituals.name: Raise Runelord
rituals.reason: Creates a risen runelord or hostile psychopomps; independent creatures and their abilities excluded.

rituals.name: Ransack the Night
rituals.reason: Concealment only; its flat checks are not saving throws.

rituals.name: Ravenous Reanimation
rituals.reason: Caster automatically dies and transforms into ravener or husk; no save.

rituals.name: Recall Past Life
rituals.reason: Explicit user project ruling: exclude pending authoritative clarification of saves for the immediately possessed dead target. Baseline and Paizo remaster errata confirm the possession wording but do not settle the save-result branch. This is a provisional scope ruling, not proof that no saving throw exists.

decision.revisitWhen: Authoritative clarification establishes saves for the ritual-produced possession.

rituals.name: Regale the Lost Ones
rituals.reason: Haunt difficulty and undead frightened/elite alterations; no saves caused by ritual.

rituals.name: Reincarnate
rituals.reason: Reincarnation, fixed irreducible conditions, or animal imprisonment; no saves.

rituals.name: Reinforced Rations
rituals.reason: Critical failure applies sickened 2, prohibits reduction for 24 hours but does not end condition then; Fortitude recovery allowed afterward under normal Sickened rules.

rituals.name: Release the Ego to Restore the Soul
rituals.reason: Counteract checks while performing or fatigue; counteract checks not saves.

rituals.name: Resolute Obliteration
rituals.reason: Object damage and caster backlash are automatic; no save.

rituals.name: Rest Eternal
rituals.reason: Unwilling spirit attempts Will save to resist sequestering.

rituals.name: Resurrect
rituals.reason: Resurrection, fixed conditions, or vague GM-directed possession/undead disaster; no concrete invoked save mechanics.

rituals.name: Retreat Among the Rains
rituals.reason: Retraining or fatigue/starvation damage without saving throw.

rituals.name: Rite of Cleansing Flame
rituals.reason: Critical failure explicitly requires DC17 Fortitude save to avoid permanent drained.

rituals.name: Rite of Repatriation
rituals.reason: Item restoration and counteraction as Dispel Magic/Cleanse Affliction; no required saves.

rituals.name: Rite of the Red Star
rituals.reason: Portal use on success and casting failures require DC36 Fortitude saves.

rituals.name: Rolling Boulders
rituals.reason: Difficult terrain, cover or automatic rock damage; no save.

rituals.name: Rune Trap
rituals.reason: Stores and releases a hostile spell when triggered. Legal save spells (e.g. Fireball) retain their saving throws, unlike independently granted spellcasting.

rituals.name: Sculpt Appearance
rituals.reason: Cosmetic transformation and social-check penalties; no saves.

rituals.name: Secure Siege Weapons
rituals.reason: Enemy weapon operation or movement triggers DC20 Will save; distinct from benefit to saves against siege attacks.

rituals.name: Seed of Mercy
rituals.reason: Toughness/healing benefits or independent summoned demon; no save.

rituals.name: Separation
rituals.reason: Unwilling targets attempt Will saves to resist separation.

rituals.name: Shadow Double
rituals.reason: Disbelief explicitly uses Perception against secondary caster Deception DC; apparent critical-save successes are illusory narration, not actual saves. No real special abilities.

rituals.name: Shroud of the Provinces
rituals.reason: Concealment/light/sound alteration and narrative urge to leave; no save or referenced fear spell.

rituals.name: Sky Signs
rituals.reason: Sky message or reversed message; no save.

rituals.name: Sleepless Season
rituals.reason: Each living target attempts Fortitude save to resist sleeplessness curse.

rituals.name: Song of Silver
rituals.reason: Teleport counteraction and save bonuses; separately granted Breath of Life excluded from qualification, fixed stupefied backlash.

rituals.name: Split Shadow
rituals.reason: Creates shadow double or greater shadow; later creature abilities are independent, with no ritual-imposed saving throw.

rituals.name: Sprawling Tunnels
rituals.reason: Creates tunnels with Perception/Survival checks; critical failure spawns elemental attackers whose later abilities are independent.

rituals.name: Statuette
rituals.reason: Shrinks objects using Shrink Item variant; restoration harmlessly pushes creatures or contains them. No saving throw.

rituals.name: Still Life Storage
rituals.reason: Stores objects in a painting; identification uses Crafting/Occultism/Perception and failure breaks objects, with no creature save.

rituals.name: Summerland Spell
rituals.reason: Weather moderation with automatic drained curse on casters; curse ends by counteraction, not a recovery save.

rituals.name: Supreme Connection
rituals.reason: Question-answering divination, social bonuses, and automatic damage/drained backlash; no save.

rituals.name: Sweetest Solstice
rituals.reason: Critical failure imposes sickened 4, prohibiting reduction for 12 hours. Once that temporary lock ends, ordinary sickened Fortitude recovery applies; unspecified town food poisoning is not needed to establish qualification.

rituals.name: Tattoo Whispers
rituals.reason: Tattoo communication and fixed-duration stupefied backlash; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Teleportation Circle
rituals.reason: Unwilling creature explicitly makes Will to resist teleportation and repeats at end of each turn remaining in circle.

rituals.name: Terminate Bloodline
rituals.reason: Conscious initial target attempts Fortitude; family-contact exposure and affliction progression also explicitly require Fortitude. Progression remains delegated.

rituals.name: The Unseeing Blade Master
rituals.reason: Grants Blind-Fight after challenge; broken sword or fixed-duration blinded backlash without saves.

rituals.name: The World's a Stage
rituals.reason: Gives skill rerolls or doomed for one month; no saving throw or recovery-save condition.

rituals.name: Transmigrate
rituals.reason: GM-only description includes rank4 basic Fortitude DC24 against critical-failure fire damage. Rank5 replaces ritual outcome rules, but rank4 suffices to qualify the catalog entry.

rituals.name: Unbearable Cacophony
rituals.reason: Sounds in ritual area explicitly deal sonic damage with basic Fortitude against ritual DC.

rituals.name: Uncouple Memory
rituals.reason: Memory switching uses an explicitly specified flat check, not a saving throw.

rituals.name: Unfettered Mark
rituals.reason: Escape tattoo grants teleportation, water movement/breathing, and electricity resistance. Backlash drained/fatigued removed only by reentering water; no saving throw in referenced spells or ritual.

rituals.name: Unsealing of Secrets
rituals.reason: Spirit answers a question or lies; no saving throw.

rituals.name: Unseen Heralds
rituals.reason: Embed Message-like illusion mouths transmit speech; critical failure prevents rest. Referenced spell is obviously illusory, with no disbelief provision or save.

rituals.name: Vital Singularity
rituals.reason: Shares HP loss with willing companions and imposes clumsy on failure; death effect has no saving throw.

rituals.name: Void Harvest
rituals.reason: First daily damage to living creature in area explicitly triggers Will save or doomed increase.

rituals.name: Ward Domain
rituals.reason: Referenced illusion disbelief does not establish a required save; optional GM substitution alone does not qualify the ritual.

rituals.name: Waters of Prediction
rituals.reason: Shows possible future scene or misleading vision, with no saving throw.

rituals.name: Wild Allegiance
rituals.reason: Grants Animal Empathy after nonviolent deeds; unspecified divine displeasure/animal attack is independent and no ritual saving throw is specified.

rituals.name: Wild Feast
rituals.reason: Critical failure directly imposes ghoul Forbidden Cravings curse. Referenced curse has Will saving throw and staged progression; affliction progression remains delegated.

rituals.name: Winter's Breath
rituals.reason: Critical failure imposes sickened 3, prohibiting reduction for 12 hours; after that lock ordinary sickened Fortitude recovery applies. Referenced restorative spells use counteraction rather than saves.

rituals.name: Wish
rituals.reason: Explicitly permits a wish to cast a chosen spell or ritual as the ritual outcome. A legal choice such as Fireball requires a Reflex save. This qualifies concrete inherited spell resolution, not invented mechanics for narrative reality changes.

rituals.name: World in Shadow
rituals.reason: Changes lighting or limits casters' vision; no saving throw or recovery-save condition.
